title: Efficient removal of aqueous Cr(VI) using sulfur-modified biochar derived from anaerobic digestate: synergistic mechanism for reduction and sorption
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00171D, Paper
Kunlun Yang, Yimei Wang, Dengyang Wang, Zengshuai Zhang, Peng Gu, Xueli Ren, Hengfeng Miao
In conjunction with separation and dehydration treatment of digestate from anaerobic acidification of food waste, sulfur-modified digestate biochar was prepared for Cr(VI) removal to realize anaerobic digestate recycle and waste control by waste.
